“Accuracy and statistical accuracy are crucial when handling personal data because they’re central to ensuring compliance with fairness principles.  The fairness principle dictates that personal data shouldn’t be used in ways that could have unjustified adverse effects on individuals.  Essentially, we need to make sure AI systems aren’t generating outputs that could be misinterpreted as factual information, especially when dealing with personal data.

Currently, the data protection principle applies to *all* personal data – whether it’s information about an individual used as input to an AI system or the AI system’s output.  However, this doesn’t mean an AI system *needs* to be 100% accurate to comply with the accuracy principle.  Instead, the focus is on ensuring the outputs are statistically informed and represent a reasonable guess about the individual’s situation.
